snippet.title: Twinkle's Galactic Tour - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at gameplay and more from Twinkle's Galactic Tour in this new trailer for the upcoming 90's anime-styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure game. Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in Twinkle's Galactic Tour. Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries. Twinkle's Galactic Tour will be available on PC.
